title: Student
description: Student record with personal information, academic details (grade, major, GPA), enrollment date, and contact information. Used for educational institutions, student management systems, and academic databases.

student_id.description: Unique student ID or enrollment number

grade.description: Current grade level or class (e.g., 10th Grade, Sophomore, Year 2)

major.description: Field of study or major subject (e.g., Computer Science, Business, Engineering)

gpa.description: Grade Point Average, typically on a scale of 0-4.0 or 0-5.0

country.description: Country where the student is located

enrolled_date.description: Date when the student enrolled in the institution

avatar.description: URL to the student's photo or avatar
